compare-sync.detail: Compare the structure or data of two databases, and review the sync script before it runs.
compare-sync.lapse: Opening it shows an alert that asks for a license.

query-insights.detail: See which queries you run most, which are slowest and which got slower, from this Mac’s history.
query-insights.lapse: The view stays, covered by a license prompt.

result-charts.detail: Draw bar, line, area and scatter charts from a result set.
result-charts.lapse: The chart stays, covered by a license prompt.

data-rewind.detail: Put back the values rows had before you saved a change.
data-rewind.lapse: Saves are no longer recorded, and restoring shows an alert.

icloud-sync.detail: Sync connections and settings between your Macs, and with the iPhone and iPad app.
icloud-sync.lapse: Sync pauses, and Settings says why.

linked-folders.detail: Read connections from shared folders of .tablepro files, such as a Git repository or a team drive.
linked-folders.lapse: Connections from linked folders leave your connection list.

encrypted-export.detail: Include passwords in a .tablepro export, encrypted with a passphrase.
encrypted-export.lapse: Exports lose the option to include passwords. Plain exports, and importing encrypted files, keep working.

environment-variables.detail: Use $VAR in connection fields such as the host or user; TablePro fills it in when you connect.
environment-variables.lapse: $VAR is no longer filled in, and nothing says so: the connection uses the text as written.

team-catalog.detail: Publish connections, without passwords, to a shared folder your team reads through Linked Folders.

team-library.detail: Share connections and saved queries with your team through TablePro’s server. Passwords are never uploaded.
team-library.lapse: Team connections and queries are hidden until a Team plan is active again.
